sixBases.arithmetic: its totals agree with six: 99,520 virtual agents = 64 x 1,555 and 1,555 = 1+6+36+216+1,296 (six bases); five bases would give 1+6+36+216+1,080 = 1,339 per gate

Her own degree_recursion.py calls it "the still-open 5-vs-6 question". This repo keeps five; v14's six is recorded here and in the guide's "To confirm" list as unresolved, and nothing was changed.
